subject.title: fix: tighten control ui input validation [AI]

question: Should accessor-like strings remain valid identifiers in schema-validated record maps while being rejected only at unsafe merge-patch object-property writes?
rationale: The choice defines the compatibility and security boundary of the public config.patch API and cannot safely be inferred from green checks alone.

options.title: Preserve validated IDs
options.body: Reject accessor-like keys only at unsafe property-write positions and add regression coverage proving schema-valid record IDs survive.

options.title: Ban identifiers globally
options.body: Treat these strings as invalid everywhere, but first align schemas, diagnostics, documentation, and upgrade behavior around that intentional contract change.

recommendation.title: Preserve validated IDs
recommendation.body: Reject accessor-like keys only at unsafe property-write positions and add regression coverage proving schema-valid record IDs survive.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config and gateway ownership is the strongest available signal for deciding this public update-boundary contract.
